name: Arena Practice Room
desc1: This room is magicked with a powerful spell, enabling people to battle
desc2: without receiving grievous injury. It is used by all to practice their
desc3: skills, and to test their preference for weapons and the like. It is
desc4: also used for those who wish to settle a grudge, but are not willing
desc5: to kill for it. The arena stands go off to the north, and a wide
desc6: staircase leads up into another practice room.
